judge.rationale: The candidate only added acceptance tests and a definition of done file (`.lore/dod.md`), completely failing to modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to fix the bug. Because `beforeSession` is still awaited outside the `try` block, two of the candidate's new acceptance tests will fail immediately. Furthermore, the candidate explicitly declared the spec and `CHANGELOG.md` updates out of scope in its DoD, despite both being explicit acceptance criteria in the issue description. Finally, it placed tests in a new separate file rather than adding to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and left behind the `.lore/dod.md` artifact.
